content.title: 1-1-5-1. Purpose.
content.summary: The purpose of the Comprehensive Plan is to provide city-wide policies to guide major decisions of the City, including decisions on zoning, annexation, and other land use related decisions.

faqs.a: The purpose of the Comprehensive Plan is to provide city-wide policies to guide major decisions of the City, including decisions on zoning, annexation, and other land use related decisions. The Comprehensive Plan, and the adopted plans which have been incorporated by reference, may include but not be limited to special focus elements such as parks, transit-oriented development, and bicycle connections.
